Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. One establishment retained, the value moving from 0.5 to 1: ARTS2 Mons, a higher arts school of the Wallonia-Brussels Federation. Criterion read at source: a master's in puppetry arts, a standalone 60-credit master's opened in September 2020, run jointly with the Academy of Fine Arts and the Puppet House in Tournai, with a teaching team of fifteen. Puppetry is the object of the award itself and the school reports to the higher education ministry of the French Community. Counted at the establishment carrying the award: the Tournai partnership does not make three schools. The previous 0.5 was the midpoint of an estimated range. Upper bound at 2: the check covered the Wallonia-Brussels Federation and did not cover Flemish arts higher education, where a course could exist under another name.

establishments.name: ARTS² — École supérieure des Arts de la Fédération Wallonie-Bruxelles
establishments.description: The higher arts school of the French Community of Belgium. Its puppetry master's, opened in September 2020, is run jointly with the Academy of Fine Arts and the Puppet House in Tournai, and is the only state-backed puppetry qualification in Belgium's French-speaking system.

observations.reasoning: DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90. To be redone in full once the denominator is settled.
